author: Cleo Abram
description:
Clouds are way heavier than most people think!

Can you guess how much this cloud weighs? And if they’re so heavy, then why don’t all the tiny water droplets fall down? Watch to find out!

And to see why the US has more tornadoes than anywhere else on Earth, subscribe! 

#cloud #weigh #water #earth #weather
title: Clouds Are Way Heavier Than You Think
